interview.secured: Going by what I saw, 'Day secured' means I finished and posted proof for that day's task, like the body check-in, so the day counts toward my streak.
interview.freeze: The app never explained 'freeze' on any screen I saw, so I'm guessing it's a way to skip a day without losing my streak, but I can't say for sure.
interview.selfReported: The app never explained 'Self-reported' to me, so I can only guess it means I just say I did the task and nothing verifies it.
